ci-bot: [auto] docs-lint failed (MD042 code fence lang). See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/builds/701/logs

anna-docs: thanks — I'll fix lint, add the snippets, reference the gist and log, and include a one-line product callout to pin to aurora-xl for sustained >4k contexts. Aiming to merge after another +1.
